edges.reason: assemble reads clusterControllerAddress for deposit commission and pricing.
disassemble reads clusterControllerAddress for redeem commission and adapter.
_coverCommission calls IController(clusterControllerAddress).getDHVPrice.
_swapEthToUnderlyings reads adapters and underlyings info from the controller.
_swapUnderlyingsToEth reads the adapter address from the controller.
Commission ETH is sent to treasuryAddress and DHV is transferred to it.
_swapEthToUnderlyings draws underlyings from and sends ETH to treasuryAddress.
cooldownPeriod is added to block.timestamp when writing cooldownTimestamps.
setCooldownPeriod writes the cooldownPeriod state variable.
assemble writes cooldownTimestamps for the caller.
checkCooldownPeriod reads cooldownTimestamps in disassemble.
checkCooldownPeriod reads cooldownTimestamps in transfer.
checkCooldownPeriod reads cooldownTimestamps in transferFrom.
mintFor writes cooldownTimestamps for the target account.
withdrawToAccumulation increases clusterLock entries.
refundFromAccumulation decreases clusterLock entries.
optimizeProportion reads and rewrites clusterLock for each underlying.
getUnderlyingBalance adds the locked amount from clusterLock.
withdrawToAccumulation increases clusterTokenLock.
refundFromAccumulation decreases clusterTokenLock.
optimizeProportion computes totalSupply() - clusterTokenLockMemo which can underflow if lock exceeds supply.
mint pulls each token listed in underlyings from the caller.
burn transfers each underlying back to the caller.
optimizeProportion iterates the underlyings array.
_swapEthToUnderlyings iterates underlyings to buy or pull them.
_swapUnderlyingsToEth approves and swaps the underlyings array.
getUnderlyingsAmountsFromClusterAmount iterates underlyings.
getUnderlyings returns the underlyings array.
optimizeProportion overwrites underlyingsShares with the new weights.
getUnderlyingsAmountsFromClusterAmount uses underlyingsShares length.
getUnderlyingShares returns the underlyingsShares array.
_coverCommission pulls DHV from the caller via dhvTokenInstance.safeTransferFrom.
msg.sender is the buyer and receiver of the minted cluster.
msg.sender is the redeemer and the cluster transferFrom sender.
msg.sender is the token holder being checked for cooldown.
msg.sender spender allowance is used in transferFrom.
msg.sender supplies the underlyings in mint.
msg.sender supplies the underlyings in mintFor.
msg.sender receives the underlyings in burn.
msg.sender is the farmer receiving tokens in withdrawToAccumulation.
msg.sender is the farmer returning tokens in refundFromAccumulation.
msg.sender is the delegate receiving or supplying the rebalance difference.
onlyAdmin requires msg.sender to hold DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE in setCooldownPeriod.
controllerChange requires msg.sender to equal clusterControllerAddress.
the ETH recipient inside _payInEth is _msgSender().
the destination of the low-level value call is the untrusted msg.sender.
block.timestamp directly determines cooldownTimestamps values.
assemble sets cooldown as block.timestamp + cooldownPeriod.
checkCooldownPeriod compares cooldownTimestamps to block.timestamp in disassemble.
checkCooldownPeriod compares cooldownTimestamps to block.timestamp in transfer.
checkCooldownPeriod compares cooldownTimestamps to block.timestamp in transferFrom.
mintFor sets cooldown as block.timestamp + cooldownPeriod.
assemble calls _coverCommission for the deposit commission.
assemble calls _swapEthToUnderlyings to buy the underlyings.
assemble indirectly relies on getUnderlyingsAmountsFromClusterAmount pricing logic.
disassemble calls _payInEth to refund the redeemer.
disassemble calls _coverCommission for the redeem commission.
disassemble calls _swapUnderlyingsToEth to obtain ETH.
disassemble calls getUnderlyingsAmountsFromClusterAmount.
mint calls getUnderlyingsAmountsFromClusterAmount.
mintFor calls getUnderlyingsAmountsFromClusterAmount.
burn calls getUnderlyingsAmountsFromClusterAmount.
optimizeProportion calls getUnderlyingsAmountsFromClusterAmount three times.
_payInEth performs the low-level value call to the caller.
_coverCommission performs a low-level value call to the treasury.
_swapEthToUnderlyings performs a low-level value call to the treasury inside the loop.
_swapEthToUnderlyings performs an external swapETHToUnderlying call on the adapter.
_swapUnderlyingsToEth performs an external swapUndelyingsToETH call on the adapter.
the ETH transfer to msg.sender can reenter disassemble before the cluster burn.
the treasury ETH transfer can reenter the commission cover path.
the treasury ETH transfer inside the loop can reenter the swap routine.
the adapter external call can reenter disassemble while approvals are still unlimited.
coverDhvWithEth selects the treasury ETH branch or the DHV transfer branch.
the commission amount queried by assemble is passed into _coverCommission.
the computed underlying amounts are passed to _swapUnderlyingsToEth.
the returned cluster price is used as denominator in the cluster amount computation.
